notes: Both variant units resolve to the base without affecting the English.
ἀνάστασιν is a noun and not a negative able to carry the negation alone, so μή keeps its own no and the pair is not joined (rules 41, 59).
τὰ ἀμφότερα → both: the ASV supplies the article neither determiner nor nominal, so rule 102 hands it nothing and rule 23 decides it.
